notes.title: [DEMO] - 0.2.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been about a month since the last update. I know many of you are eager for the next wave of content, but I'd like to ask for just a bit more patience. While the new content is in development, I don’t want to release anything too early.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, I also didn’t want to leave the game dead until I'm done with the next big update. 
So, in version 0.2.1, I'd like to introduce a new feature: [b]Game History[/b].

Alongside that, this version is also packed with a set of QoL patches and bug fixes that I hope will improve your gameplay experience.


As always, thank you for keeping up with the patches and enjoying Insider Trading.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
The changes on 0.2.1 are as follows:


[b]Play History:[/b][/p][p]All finished games will now be saved under '[b]GAME HISTORY' [/b]tab in the main menu.

Clicking an archived save will reload the finished games, allowing you to look back at the decks and charts you created through each gameplay.

Note that games completed before this patch will not show up in the panel.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/63f9d25727a32f05a3a7730d227c6abb9d4111da.png"][/img][b]


Minor Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Toggle Win/Loss Screen Visibility [/b]at game end. An 'eye' icon will appear at the bottom left corner, allowing you to look back at your game data.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quicker Restarts. [/b]If you give up your game by clicking the flag icon at the bottom left corner, the game will restart without going through the game over animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Alternatively, [b]pressing 'R' [/b]will now do the same thing as pressing the flag icon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The mouse cursor [/b]will now change a bit more clearly when toggling 'move' or 'remove' modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combos will now be visible[/b] even if you don't hover your mouse over the cards.[/p][/*][*][p]The combo tooltip with the '(?)' icon will now show you how many cards you need for a combo to be made.[/p][/*][*][p]Game version is made visible under the chart panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Authorization has been greatly reduced. [/b]Players have repeatedly reported a problem where the game detects the user to be offline even when they are not. I found the current authorization system to have more downsides than upsides; therefore, this system has now been greatly reduced. I hope this will allow more users to play the game with ease.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cards will no longer be enlarged to infinity, [/b]on higher retrigger counts.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/e764586d7473454877464544888f72902008a26e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Exiting the game on day 1 will now normally save your game.[/p][/*][*][p]Save files will not be randomly deleted upon exiting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the game speed desynchronized with the background music in longer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Restarting the game by clicking the flag icon will now add a loss to your lifetime statistics.[/p][/*][*][p]Reset will no longer break when disabled by the 'Picker's Market' event.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening the settings menu during the tutorial will no longer softlock the gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Chart color adjustments in the localization tab will now work as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where 'Short Sponcers' triggered multiple times on the same day.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Aside from these, I am aware there are several wording inconsistencies or badly written card descriptions. I'm sorry for the inconvenience these cause, but I promise this issue will be fixed in the next major update as I rework pre-existing cards and add more content.

[/p][hr][/hr][p]
That's all for this patch.

While nothing can be officialized, there is a substantial chance that I'll be inviting a small group of users for [b]playtesting[/b], before, or around the time of the next major update. 
The playtest version is likely to feature 8 full weeks of gameplay, plus an infinity mode, alongside added content.

If you are interested in participating, first, [i]thank you[/i], and second, I advise you to join the Discord, as that is where the related announcements will be made.

[/p][p]With that said, I'll be off to work further on the next patch.
[b]As always, thank you all for playing Insider Trading, and staying in the loop.
[/b]

[b]Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5"]https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5[/url]
[/p]

notes.title: [DEMO] 0.2.0 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]This 0.2 update features changes and additions to the event mechanic, alongside various quality-of-life patches and bug fixes.

Please note that all patches on the demo version are subject to changes. If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or concerns regarding the 0.2 update or the general gameplay, please feel free to share them on the Discord or the Steam discussion page.

As always, thank you for keeping up with the patches and enjoying Insider Trading.

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
The changes on 0.2 are as follows:


[b]Events:[/b][/p][p]There have been mixed suggestions and feedback regarding the weekly events. Some found it enjoyable, while some found it to be overly punishing without many workarounds or simply too complicated.  I've been experimenting with different ways to modify the event system, to come to the conclusion that better designing of individual events and improved visual clarity are all that is necessary for now.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/df715c1a23fcd6606ec163b70ba5bfe5e4701ec1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The general event mechanic will remain the same, with minor additions and changes to its details.[/p][list][*][p][b]Five new events[/b] have been added to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Events are now displayed in the [b]bottom center, [/b]next to the date. This visual change was made to differentiate it further from regular perks.[/p][/*][*][p]The event pool has been slightly modified, so [b]certain events only spawn on specific weeks[/b]. This feature was added to prevent certain events having too much impact, or too little impact when spawning early into the game. This feature will gain more presence in the full release, where the game will extend to 8 weeks or beyond.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recession [/b]event, enabling [b]Short Selling, [/b]will be treated as the one and only 'special event'. To go into the details, UI will be modified more clearly when this event is active, and its [b]spawn chance will scale[/b] based on how much the stock price has risen in the past week. This change was made due to the impact short selling had, compared to all other events. [b]This will allow Recession to spawn at a good rate, regardless of how many events there are in the game.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Recession events will no longer spawn in the last week. [/b]This will allow players to always shoot the price with no limit on the final week.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manipulation [/b]event has been reworked to [b]Short Sponsors [/b]event. This event will now give or deduct tokens based on the daily price change, whereas the previous version changed tokens based on the week's starting price.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Quality of Life:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/a3e4dda19f95d681329bf3498bdc39aad67dd145.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Saturated Colors Options[/b] has now been added to the game. Disabling this option will desaturate the game slightly, making the visuals less stressful for the eyes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daily Price Change [/b]is now displayed in the 'price' bracket at the end of every day. This will give you an indication of how the price changed, even when you skip.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shine Effect on 'Market Value' bracket has been reduced. [/b]It will no longer blind your eyes even at higher % changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Normal [/b]will now turn green when it can change the price by a positive amount.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deleted Cards in the Queue [/b]will now have more visual clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Picker's Market, [/b]when active, will visibly show the first five cards in the queue are deactivated before the queue is played.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The icon for the 'Null' Card has been recreated.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Price changes for 'Chimp' and 'Champ'[/b](change price by a random amount between +/-0%~10%)[b], [/b]are now displayed in the corner of their cards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dates will now change at the proper moment, [/b]after the daily report bar has been filled up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feeder perk will now trigger as intended, [/b]triggering max 5 times for EACH card it may affect. There has previously been a bug that limited the trigger count to max 5 times a day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a corruption issue in the game's settings file.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game starting with a price that's slightly off $100.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Mirror [/b]card not copying internal data (stacks, upgrades, etc.).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's it for this patch. I'd love to hear what you think of the changed and added events, and make further adjustments based on it. Also, I'd expect the event pool to change around a bit until the final release, as more cards and perks get added on.  [/p][p][/p][p]Talking about cards and perks, a bit of a change in the card pool is expected over the next few weeks. I am taking notes on a few synergies and cards that are overpowered at the moment, such as the monkey deck, or the final sprint perk, and will make balance changes as the card pool gets altered.[b] 


[/b]I am paying close attention to all the feedback that is left in the Discord, or the Steam discussion page, and will be on constant lookout to improve the game based on that. Seamless background music with more variety, collections screen, meta progression, more content, past game log, cat cards, UI tweaks, and so on will be implemented as the development continues.[b]


Again, thank you all for playing Insider Trading. [/b]For bug reports, feedback, and suggestions, please use our official Discord.[/p]

notes.title: 0.1.3 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]EDIT (6/28): Despite claiming the next update 'will come towards the end of June', it will be postponed slightly. I apologize for the delay.[/p][p][/p][p]I want to start off by saying THANK YOU to all of you for playing Insider Trading and sharing your thoughts on the game so far. [/p][p]With Next Fest finished earlier this week, Insider Trading stands at 14,000 wishlists. I consider this to be a great achievement that would not have been possible without your support.
[/p][p]
With that being said, this minor patch features yet another QoL, UI/UX changes, and bug fixes.

Content updates will come towards the end of June - this will mainly feature an overhaul of the events, and the 'Short Selling' system. [/p][p]Content additions on cards, perks, and characters are expected during July and August.

[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
The changes on 0.1.3 are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/495bf20843346a3dbdcfe68fdf1a1b6c375dbfe5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]QoL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Togglable [b]'Day Separators'[/b] have been added, marking when a day started or ended right on the chart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zoom in / Out[/b] feature has been added to see the bigger scope of your progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4x game speed[/b] has been added (previous max was 2x).[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of shares bought is now previewed when hovering the cursor above 'trade' button.[/p][/*][*][p]Readability for card modification costs has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]A tooltip has been added to explain the Combo system - more tooltips will come in the future for new user support.[/p][/*][*][p]Deck display modes(DISCARD, FULL DECK, REMAINING) are now immediately swapped through clicking arrows, rather than having to close out and reopen the display.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/0693f755757fa58877ebc5e8e96b0afb0d0a6cd3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Localization:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Chart colors can now be customized [/b]inside the language tab. This feature has been requested by international users who had a different color scheme for candle charts. Please note for the time being that this only affects the chart and no other UI elements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/b78efb132301399c5e75ba1eb283875cb79dcf6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/p][p]While I am reluctant to touch on balancing before content additions are to come, a few had to be changed due to them causing undesirable results.[/p][list][*][p][b]Perk, FEEDER, [/b]has been capped to add +5 maximum retriggers on a single card. Previously uncapped, Feeder often caused infinite loops when multiple copies were held at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rapidfire [/b]has been changed into a [b]RARE [/b]perk. (Previously common). Multiple copies of this perk, together with 'New Normal', have been causing overflows a bit too often. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]Most bug fixes have been made with immediacy, without a separate announcement throughout the past week. The following is a list of what has been changed.[/p][list][*][p]Freeze during the tutorial, which occurs for certain users, has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Display bugs for FOMO, Flock, and Birdman have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Bug with Flock, and Upturn event has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Volume slider now adjusts the volumes linearly, as intended (previously exponential)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed '[b]screenshake[/b]' setting failing to affect screen shake effects in certain animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed '[b]Reset' [/b]not triggering in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game off-positioning itself in setups with multiple monitors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Again, thank you all for playing Insider Trading.
For bug reports, feedback, and suggestions, please use our official Discord.

[b]Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5"]https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5[/url][/p]

notes.title: 0.1.2 Patch Notes (KR/CN/JP translations)

Alongside bug fixes and minor balance adjustments, beta translations have been made for CJK languages.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/d1431fe410aef645d8506a606294e5d757911629.png"][/img]
[b]Beta Localization for 4 languages[/b][/p][list][*][p]Translation added for Korean, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Japanese[/p][p]This can be accessed from the title screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/c1287d0f3777fab9e945a19865fa95958f3682c5.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an inconsistent crash that occurred when returning to the main menu or replaying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the infinite trigger bug on the [b]Swan[/b] card. notes.title: [MINOR UPDATE] 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello,
It's been three days since the demo has been released. 
I thank you all for playing the demo, and providing wonderful feedback on the game's direction.

[b]Speaking of Feedback...[/b][/p][p]Many users have been negatively reacting to several events, especially the [b]Manipulator[/b], which changes your tokens by +/-10 depending on the stock price. Although I have temporarily nerfed this specific event in this patch, I will quickly seek ways to completely overhaul this and other events.[/p][p]
Another issue that was commonly brought up was the inability to buy stocks when the price exceeded $1,000. Many players thought this was a bug, or an unpleasant mechanic. Similar to events, I have added a temporary UI to warn players when the price exceeds $1,000, but in the long term, I will seek ways to change this mechanic.[/p][p]
Major updates regarding these problems are soon to come, but for now, this update focuses on quick bug fixes, and QoL patches.
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
The changes are as follows:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225045/91c3003a5ed09a82500d82b38fc2f148b6e7b88e.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[b]QoL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a small UI displaying each card's effects as they trigger (can be switched on and off in settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more QoL settings, including an option to enlarge tooltips and tooltip texts[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips for each option in the settings[/p][/*][*][p]Broke down graphic settings into more detailed criteria[/p][/*][*][p]Capped minimum price to $0.0000001[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning tooltip when the price exceeds $1,000 or reaches the capped minimum[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Balancing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nerfed [b]Monkey Business [/b]to buff other monkeys by +1.5x, effect stacking linearly with each trigger (previously exponentially). This will keep the card's power at about the same level in lower trigger counts, and weaken it in higher trigger counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed [b]Manipulator [/b]event to modify tokens by +/-7 (previously +/-10).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed sound adjustment not functioning properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam initialization, causing crashes for certain users[/p][/*][*][p]Recentered 'Game Over' screen[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of background animations in the start screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the crash happening during the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain cards modifying stock price by more than -99%, causing an overflow in the balance[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]
I will constantly be fixing bugs or balancing issues as they come up; but I expect the next patch log to consist of larger changes[i], [/i]mainly touching on the core mechanics.

If you have any suggestions to give, or bugs to report, please do so through our Discord channel.

Again, thanks to all of you for playing Insider Trading. 
Please drop a Steam review to share your experience.


[b]Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5"]https://discord.com/invite/AxcWFHCDn5[/url]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo for Insider Trading is Released
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is Naiive, the developer of Insider Trading.
After a year of development and continuous playtesting, I am happy to announce the Demo for Insider Trading is now released.
Demo will be up for an indefinite amount of time.


I am looking forward to your feedback and reviews through Steam page, or through the official Discord. The game can only be complete with your experience!

Thank you, and I hope you enjoy.
